title: Castillos et al. 2023, Burst c-VEP, 100% amplitude depth: Burst c-VEP Based BCI: Optimizing stimulus design for enhanced classification with minimal calibration data and improved user experience
description: EEG recordings from 12 healthy participants performing an offline 4-class code-modulated visual evoked potential (c-VEP) task with burst c-VEP stimulation at 100% amplitude depth. Burst sequences consist of short aperiodic flashes at 2-4 flashes per second. The dataset supports reactive brain-computer interface research on stimulus design, minimal calibration data, and user experience. Data were recorded with a 32-channel BrainProducts LiveAmp system.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 500 Hz with a 32-channel BrainProducts LiveAmp system (active Acticap electrodes, reference FCz). Participants focused on cued targets in a factorial design (burst vs m-sequence, 100% vs 40% amplitude depth) presented on a 60 Hz monitor with PsychoPy. Data were decoded with a CNN using 250 ms sliding windows and Pearson correlation for target selection.
